message.content:
Berlin is **9 hours ahead of Los Angeles**.  
During U.S. daylight‑saving time (Los Angeles = UTC‑7) and German daylight‑saving time (Berlin = UTC+2), the offset stays 9 hours. In standard time it’s also 9 hours (Berlin = UTC+1, Los Angeles = UTC‑8). Thus, when it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 p.m. in Berlin.
